thread:
sara_support: Hey team, customer hit a production break after upgrading node-sdk to 2.3.1. Next.js production build on Vercel/Turbopack - auth 401s only from Edge functions. Works in local dev.
eng_ryan: Oof. Are we seeing ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED or auth header getting stripped?
sara_support: No path error in app logs, just 401 from our API with valid key. Repro steps from customer below.
devon: Paste the repro? short steps are fine.
sara_support: Steps: 1) next build (Turbopack on), 2) deploy to Vercel Edge, 3) serverless edge route imports our package normally: `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` 4) calls generation -> 401. They rolled back to 2.2.8 and it works.
jordan_pm: Any bundle differences between 2.2.8 and 2.3.1 in package.json exports?
sara_support: Customer attached minimal package.json snippet: ```json
{"name":"app","dependencies":{"redwood-sdk":"^2.3.1"}}
```
devon: Can we get their node & bundler versions? Edge often uses newer v18+ and ESM only.
sara_support: Vercel runtime: edge (node 20), turbopack enabled. Customer says bundle output shows our package ending up as ESM namespace without default import.
eng_ryan: That matches a conditional exports/dual-entry regression we shipped in 2.3.1. Possible that the exports map no longer exposes the CJS entrypoint used by some bundlers, causing runtime to drop auth shim.
sara_support: They also sent a short log from the edge: ```
Incoming request: POST /v1/complete -> forwarded to inference (tok=xxx)
Response from Redwood API: 401 Unauthorized (x-request-id: abcd1234)
SDK: attempted retry x3, final 401
```
devon: Ask them to run a quick local bundle with esbuild to replicate: `esbuild --bundle node_modules/redwood-sdk --format=cjs` and see warnings. Also ask for `node -p "require('redwood-sdk/package.json').exports"` output from a serverless environment if possible.
sara_support: Sent. Customer returned: exports map on 2.3.1 is: ```json
{"./edge": "./dist/edge.mjs", "./node": "./dist/node.cjs", "./package.json": "./package.json"}
``` They said not all bundlers read conditional keys the same way.
eng_ryan: Huh — we intended `.` and `./*` entries. If we missed a root `.` export, tools that import 'redwood-sdk' without subpath may fall back to package.json's module field or to resolved ESM which could strip runtime shims. That's probably the auth header shim not being included.
jordan_pm: What's a quick workaround for customers until we patch?
devon: Workaround: import explicit entrypoint in their edge code: `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk/edge'` or pin to 2.2.8. Also they can force CJS by importing require from `redwood-sdk/dist/node.cjs` but that's ugly.
sara_support: Customer tried `redwood-sdk/edge` and that fixed the 401s. They asked if we can publish a patch.
eng_ryan: I'll prepare 2.3.2 to add missing "\." export and ensure `./package.json` and types subpaths are present. Also add CI test for Turbopack and esbuild bundling.
sre_tim: Any chance this caused retries to saturate their edge concurrency? They mentioned latency spikes.
sara_support: They saw retries x3 per request, and overall p95 latency jumped while retries happened.
devon: We'll also add an automatic fallback in runtime: if auth shim not present, try to use env API key header from global process env or throw clearer error.
eng_ryan: Ok I'll cut 2.3.2 with patch notes: - restore root export "." to point to ./dist/node.cjs and ./dist/edge.mjs via conditional exports, - include package.json in exports, - include types subpaths, - add turbopack/esbuild bundler test. ETA 2h.
jordan_pm: Communicate to the customer: short note + workaround + ETA. Sara can you message them now?
sara_support: On it. Replying: "Temporary workaround: import 'redwood-sdk/edge' in your Edge routes or pin to 2.2.8. We're releasing 2.3.2 (~2 hours) to fix exports map and bundler edge cases. Sorry for the outage." :pray:
buildbot: deploy job #9821 started for redwood-sdk@2.3.2 (patch).
eng_ryan: CI caught an additional types path missing, fixed in branch.
sara_support: Customer ack'd and will test once 2.3.2 is out. Will reopen if issue persists.
devon: After release, follow-up: add a short docs note about bundler compatibility & recommended explicit subpath imports for Edge runtimes.
sre_tim: Also add observability: detect if requests are failing with 401 only from Edge/runtimes and tag them for quick rollback.
jordan_pm: Thanks team, good triage.
sara_support: Closing thread once customer verifies fix.
